scope: 32 training-cache frames, fixed sample0..31 each; only frame0 selected pairs; no validation/AEE claim
service_definition: CSV cycles=sum(state0..state13)-1; start already included, do not add go. Per-packet reset/cache cold, own parameter reads included; source kernel only.
bytes_definition: 16 bytes per accepted 128-bit request, including demand/speculative/repeated graph reads. Prefetch is a subset, not an additional term; no FC1 traffic here.
resource_contract: Same source RTL, 128B cache, parameter-request rights, packed32 graph and prefetch; all use D-only entropy order.
